# walite v0.5.0

walite is a lightweight, keyboard-driven WhatsApp client for the terminal. This release adds ready-to-run archives for Linux and macOS on Intel/AMD and ARM64 systems, so Go is not required for installation.

![walite terminal interface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antoinebaudrimont-beep/walite/v0.5.0/docs/screenshots/walite-terminal.png)

## Highlights

- Keyboard-first terminal interface with four themes
- Cached startup and bounded chat and message working sets
- Text messages, quoted replies and reactions
- Explicit sending and downloading of images, video, audio and documents
- Optional Linux/X11 inline image, GIF and WebP sticker previews
- Native macOS integration for opening media and copying links
- Reproducible archives with SHA-256 checksums

## Download

Choose the archive matching your operating system and processor:

| System | Processor | Archive |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linux | Intel or AMD 64-bit | [linux/amd64](https://github.com/antoinebaudrimont-beep/walite/releases/download/v0.5.0/walite_v0.5.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz) |
| Linux | ARM64 | [linux/arm64](https://github.com/antoinebaudrimont-beep/walite/releases/download/v0.5.0/walite_v0.5.0_linux_arm64.tar.gz) |
| macOS | Intel | [darwin/amd64](https://github.com/antoinebaudrimont-beep/walite/releases/download/v0.5.0/walite_v0.5.0_darwin_amd64.tar.gz) |
| macOS | Apple Silicon | [darwin/arm64](https://github.com/antoinebaudrimont-beep/walite/releases/download/v0.5.0/walite_v0.5.0_darwin_arm64.tar.gz) |

Also download [SHA256SUMS](https://github.com/antoinebaudrimont-beep/walite/releases/download/v0.5.0/SHA256SUMS) to verify the archive.

## Quick start

Example for a 64-bit Intel/AMD Linux computer:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf walite_v0.5.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
./walite --pair
./walite
```

For first-time pairing, open **WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device** on your phone and scan the QR code shown by walite. Later launches reuse the linked session.

The macOS binaries are not code-signed or notarized. See the [README](https://github.com/antoinebaudrimont-beep/walite#prebuilt-releases) for the first-launch instructions, optional Linux helpers, controls and current limitations.

walite is unofficial and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.
